pages.title: Step 2: Loading Greenware
pages.text: When the kiln enters Stage 1, right-click the top of the pit kiln with greenware to load it. Up to 4 greenware items can be loaded.$(br2)§cNote: No items can be placed without the grate installed! You must install the grate first (Stage 0 → Stage 1) before loading.$(br2)Greenware items are placed/retrieved by the §5click position§0: the kiln top is divided into §5front-left, front-right, back-left, back-right§0 four slots. Click the corresponding position to operate. When the target slot is occupied, it automatically fills the remaining empty slots.$(br2)To remove loaded items, right-click the top at the slot location with an empty hand (non-Shift mode).

pages.title: Greenware Types
pages.text: Three types of greenware can be loaded:$(br)$(li)§3Crucible Greenware§r → §3Gray Crucible§r$(br)$(li)§4Mold Greenware§r → §4Red Mold§r$(br)$(li)§8Brick Greenware§r → §8Fired Brick§r$(br)Each requires different firing conditions. Failure produces kiln waste shards.
Crafting recipe for crucible greenware. Requires drying on a drying rack before use.

pages.title: Adding Fuel & Sealing
pages.text: After loading, right-click the fire mouth with fuel to add it. Supported fuel types:$(br2)$(li)§4Firewood§r: fuel value 4 (1800 ticks/90 seconds each)$(br)$(li)§4Straw Bale§r: fuel value 1$(br)$(li)§8Rice Husk Char§r: fuel value 6 (best fuel)$(br)$(li)§8Charcoal Block§r: fuel value 1$(br2)After adding fuel, right-click the top with a kiln lid to seal. The kiln enters Stage 2.
Crafting recipe for the kiln lid. Sealing the kiln enters the heating stage.
Crafting recipe for straw bale. Low fuel value but simple to make.
§8Rice Husk Char§r is the best fuel for pit kiln firing, with a fuel value of 6 and the longest burn time. Obtained by smelting rice husk in a furnace.
